business_problem: EOS Group is a technology-driven financial services company headquartered in Germany and operates in more than 20 countries worldwide. EOS Group's IT division, EOS Technology Solutions, provides critical services, such as data warehouse solutions and IT-infrastructure support, to other members of its parent company, Otto Group.
solution_summary: EOS Group , a leading financial services company, was storing its ever-increasing volumes of data in its on-premises data warehouse, leading to delays in data processing and analytics. This hindered the company's ability to make timely and informed decisions to support business growth and competitiveness. Recognizing the need for a scalable, high-performance solution, EOS Group decided to migrate its data warehouse to the cloud and chose services offered by Amazon Web Services (AWS). In terms of migration planning and implementation, EOS Group followed the AWS Migration Acceleration Program (AWS MAP), which is a comprehensive and proven cloud migration program. AWS MAP consists of three phases: Assess, Mobilize, and Migrate and Modernize.

solution_components.name: Amazon S3
solution_components.role: Stores source data, documents, or generated artifacts used by the data platform and analytics workflows.

solution_components.name: Amazon Redshift
solution_components.role: Serves as the analytics warehouse for the data platform and analytics workflows.

solution_components.name: AWS DMS
solution_components.role: Migrates source data into the modernized environment behind the data platform and analytics workflows.

data_flow: This helped EOS Group to securely process and store sensitive data in the cloud while meeting the stringent data protection requirements of the financial services sector.
business_outcome: Looking ahead, EOS Group plans to use the data-sharing feature of Amazon Redshift to make commonly used data more accessible across the organization. This improved access to high-quality data will enhance decision-making and provide a competitive advantage for new portfolio purchases.
